**Overview:**  
Everbright Mega Kopi Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company that provides halal catering for corporate events and weddings. It is based in Kuala Lumpur and was incorporated on 5 August 2014. The firm has a share capital of RM 1,000,000, with a single shareholder owning 67.36% of the equity. Reported revenue figures range from RM 31,626,551 to RM 51,652,812, with the most recent disclosed amount at RM 51,652,812. The company has no recorded legal cases as defendant.
